en: A sepia-toned image likely from the early 20th century, showing a large, pointed-roof building resembling a chapel, mausoleum, or crematorium with Gothic and Romanesque architectural elements. To the right, there is a ruin-like stone structure, possibly a grotto or a small chapel ruin, surrounded by garden landscaping and shrubbery. The area appears well-maintained, with a clear path leading up to the main building.
